traits.name: Alter Dweomer
traits.text: ⬲ (abjuration, arcane); Trigger The dweomercat is targeted by a spell or is within the area of a spell as it is cast Effect The dweomercat gains an effect related to the school of the triggering spell. This effect occurs before the dweomercat is affected by the triggering spell. The effect lasts for 1 minute, until the dweomercat uses this ability again, or until the dweomercat Dismisses the effect, whichever comes first.

traits.name: Abjuration
traits.text: The dweomercat gains a +1 status bonus to AC.

traits.name: Conjuration
traits.text: A cloud of fog appears in a 5-foot burst centered on a corner of the dweomercat's space. Anything in the cloud is concealed.

traits.name: Divination
traits.text: The dweomercat gains a +1 status bonus to all skill checks.

traits.name: Enchantment
traits.text: The dweomercat gains a +1 status bonus to all saves.

traits.name: Evocation
traits.text: Magical feedback deals 4d6 (4d6) force damage to the triggering spellcaster (DC 22 basic Reflex save).

traits.name: Illusion
traits.text: The dweomercat becomes invisible. This effect ends if the dweomercat uses a hostile action, in addition to the normal end conditions.

traits.name: Transmutation
traits.text: The dweomercat gains a +1 status bonus to all attack rolls.

traits.name: Dweomer Leap
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, conjuration, teleportation); The dweomercat casts dimension door, then can make a melee Strike against one creature adjacent to it at the end of its teleport. If the dweomercat ends its teleport adjacent to a creature under an ongoing spell effect or who cast a spell since the dweomercat's last turn, this does not expend a casting of dimension door.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: ⬻ The dweomercat Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the dweomercat began this action hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.
